headline: Oil Surges, Treasury Yields Climb a Fifth Day, Software Retreats: Stock Market Today
summary: The 10-year Treasury yield hit a 19-month high and crude jumped above $88 as traders lifted Fed rate-hike odds to 68%, cracking high-multiple software stocks.

headline: These 7 Energy Stocks Are Rallying as Crude Tops $90 on US Strikes in Iran
summary: US strikes on Iran near the Strait of Hormuz sent WTI crude up 5.4% to $90.38. Seven energy stocks rallied and the 10-year yield hit 4.80%.
